```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggpubr)
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(limma)

```

# Load expression data

```{r}

# path to raw counts files:
rev_path = "/Volumes/pu1918/home/AS_astrocytes/RNA_revision/results/all_counts.txt"
all_counts = read.table(rev_path, sep="\t", header=TRUE)

# restrict to counts
all_counts = all_counts[c(38:nrow(all_counts)),]
PCA_names = colnames(all_counts) %>% grep("PCA",.,value=TRUE)
keep_names = setdiff(colnames(all_counts), PCA_names)
all_counts = all_counts[,c(keep_names)]
rownames(all_counts) <- all_counts$X
all_counts = all_counts[,c(4:ncol(all_counts))]

# format
all_counts <- as.matrix(all_counts)
mode(all_counts) <- "numeric" 

# build metadata 
sample_info = data.frame(sample = colnames(all_counts))
sample_info$cell_line <- str_extract(sample_info$sample, "ctrl2|ctrl3") %>% splus2R::lowerCase()
sample_info$group <- str_extract(sample_info$sample, "BtoN|CtoN|N|C|B")

# simplify group label
sample_info$group_simple <- sample_info$group
sample_info$group_simple[sample_info$group_simple %in% c("N")] <- "N"
sample_info$group_simple[sample_info$group_simple %in% c("BMP4","B")] <- "BMP4"
sample_info$group_simple[sample_info$group_simple %in% c("CNTF","C")] <- "CNTF"


# make a dds object for vst normalization
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = all_counts,
  colData   = sample_info,
  design = ~ 1
)

# keep relevant samples
keep_cols = grep("_N",colnames(dds), value=TRUE, invert=TRUE)
dds = dds[,keep_cols]
# Estimate size factors (library size normalisation)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
# Variance stabilising transform
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
# Extract a numeric matrix for PCA / correlation
mat <- assay(vsd)

```


# Sample correlation

```{R, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}

cor_mat <- cor(mat, method = "pearson")
sample_info = colData(dds)
rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample
annotation_col <- sample_info[, c("group", "cell_line")]  # or whichever columns
rownames(annotation_col) <- rownames(sample_info)     # should match colnames(cor_mat)

annotation_df <- as.data.frame(annotation_col)

pheatmap(
  cor_mat,
  annotation_col = annotation_df,
  clustering_method = "complete",
  color = colorRampPalette((brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "YlGnBu")))(100),
  border_color = NA
)
```
```{r}
# regress out the effects of the cell_line

annotation_df <- as.data.frame(annotation_col)  # if still DFrame
annotation_df$cell_line <- factor(annotation_df$cell_line)

# Make sure samples match and are ordered
expr_mat <- mat[, rownames(annotation_df)]
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_mat) == rownames(annotation_df)))

# Design matrix with intercept + cell_line
design <- model.matrix(~ cell_line, data = annotation_df)

expr_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(
  expr_mat,
  batch = annotation_df$cell_line
)

# Now compute correlations on corrected expression
cor_mat_resid <- cor(expr_corrected, method = "pearson")

# Heatmap with your annotations
pheatmap(
  cor_mat_resid,
  annotation_col = annotation_df,
  clustering_method = "complete",
  color = colorRampPalette((brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "YlGnBu")))(100),
  border_color = NA
)

```

# Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

```{r}
# PCA with prcomp 
pca <- prcomp(t(mat), scale. = FALSE)  # t() because prcomp expects variables in columns

# Proportion of variance explained
pca_var <- pca$sdev^2
pca_var_explained <- pca_var / sum(pca_var)

pc1_var <- round(pca_var_explained[1] * 100, 1)
pc2_var <- round(pca_var_explained[2] * 100, 1)

# Bring into a data frame with metadata
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
pca_df$sample <- rownames(pca_df)
pca_df <- merge(pca_df, sample_info, by = "sample", all.x = TRUE)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group_simple, shape = cell_line)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "% variance)"),
    color = "Group",
    shape = "cell_line",
    title = " "
  )
```
